WHAT: Parakeet ONNX Runtime with DirectML execution provider for Windows GPU inference
WHERE: Future `platforms/windows/parakeet_backend.rs` + Cargo.toml
HOW:
```toml
parakeet-rs = { version = "0.3.4", features = ["directml"] }
```
```rust
let config = ExecutionConfig::new()
    .with_execution_provider(ExecutionProvider::Directml);
// REQUIRED: ORT session must have:
// - execution_mode = ORT_SEQUENTIAL (not parallel)
// - enable_mem_pattern = false
```
WHY: DirectML covers all DX12 GPUs (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel) — Microsoft's recommended cross-vendor Windows GPU path
GOTCHA: 
- Ship `DirectML.dll` NEXT TO your .exe — Windows may load older System32 version causing crashes
- `onnxruntime.dll` ~150MB + `DirectML.dll` ~13MB = ~200MB extra install size
- parakeet-rs auto-falls back to CPU if DirectML fails
- Models: `istupakov/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2-onnx` or `onnx-community/parakeet-ctc-0.6b-ONNX` on HuggingFace
- INT8 quantized variant exists (~2-3x faster on low-power hardware)
